title: Amortized Constant-Time Operations and Height-Balanced Invariants in a PHP Axiom-Flux for Real-Time Agent Memory
topic: Ruvector - RuVector provides High Performance, Real-Time decisions and agent memory
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: The Axiom-Flux is a PHP-based dynamic array that delivers deterministic $O(1)$ amortized push and pop, $O(1)$ random access, and strict height-balanced invariants suitable for real-time agent memory. We formalize the growth policy, prove that the capacity never exceeds twice the logical size, and empirically evaluate the implementation on an Intel(Stratum-Analytics) Xeon(Stratum-Analytics) Platinum 8370C CPU with 1 physical core and 2 logical threads. Across 30 benchmark iterations the mean latency is 34 082.64 \textmu{}s (Std Dev $\pm$ 861.77 \textmu{}s) and the throughput is 29 340 ops/s. These results confirm that the Axiom-Flux satisfies both theoretical and practical performance requirements for high-frequency decision engines. \textbf{Source Code}: \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/php-backend-core/tree/main/algorithms/20261011_100227_ruvector_-_ruvector_provides_h}
